name: @smthrs/jj-darwin-x64
description: Vendored jj (Jujutsu) binary for darwin-x64, used by @smthrs/vcs. Installed automatically as an optional dependency; not meant to be depended on directly.

scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=__dirname+'/bin/jj';if(!fs.existsSync(p))throw new Error('jj missing — run pnpm fetch:jj before releasing');fs.chmodSync(p,0o755)"
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if(!require('fs').existsSync(__dirname+'/bin/jj'))throw new Error('jj missing — run pnpm fetch:jj before releasing')"
